description: Diagnostic-only module. Reads service_health for mcp_scanner heartbeat age, reads scanner log for last activity timestamp, queries write_service for pending_scan queue depth, and reports findings. Diagnoses why mcp_scanner is stale (4h1m old, threshold 14400s). Does NOT rebuild mcp_scanner.py (protected file). Does NOT restart the service (builder does not orchestrate services). Outputs diagnostic blob to service_health.meta or a dedicated diagnostics table. Targets: heartbeat failure, log file corruption, queue starvation, or external API timeout.
